message.content: Based on the discussions provided, LiHua finds multiple aspects of Black Myth: Wukong to be immersive. Specifically, she mentions enjoying the exploration aspect, finding it "so fun for me, finding new areas and secrets." Additionally, her statement that the combat style "blends with the storyline" indicates that she finds the integration of gameplay mechanics and narrative compelling, contributing to the overall immersion. LiHua also appreciates the storytelling, noting that the combat has "some unique mechanics that make it fun," suggesting that the game's narrative elements and gameplay interplay are particularly engaging.
